height="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ck1" value="<div style='text-align:left;font-size:10px'>1. findByTenantIdAndCheckoutIdempotencyKey → existe? replay<br>2. CartRepository.lockByTenantIdAndId (carts FOR UPDATE) — serializa duplo clique<br>3. re-lookup da chave (pode ter commitado enquanto esperava)<br>4. revalida SKU/produto/preço → PriceChangedException 409 + reprice<br>5. PricingService.quote (morada) · reserva stock por skuId ordenado (FOR UPDATE)<br>6. save Order + Payment(mesma chave) + Delivery(PIN HMAC); cart CHECKED_OUT<br>7. DataIntegrityViolation (uq_orders_tenant_checkout_key) → replay em nova tx readOnly<br>replay só p/ mesmo cliente, carrinho e morada; senão 409 idempotency_key_reused</div>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=8;fontSize=11;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;align=left;spacingLeft=6;verticalAlign=top;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="1800" y="500" width="460" height="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rf0" value="<b style='font-size:12px'>Idempotência de reembolsos</b>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=8;fontSize=11;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="1800" y="680" width="460" height="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rf1" value="<div style='text-align:left;font-size:10px'>• RefundRequest.idempotencyKey (corpo) · Sales: header Idempotency-Key (omisso → sales-refund-&lt;uuid&gt;)<br>• rejeição do vendedor: chave seller-reject-&lt;orderId&gt; (legado vendor-rejection-&lt;orderId&gt;)<br>• UNIQUE (tenant_id, idempotency_key) em refunds (V040) e payments<br>• chave repetida → mesmo Refund · chave de outro pagamento/encomenda → 409 idempotency_conflict<br>• Σ reembolsos não rejeitados ≤ payment.amount → senão 422 (lock do pagamento serializa)</div>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=8;fontSize=11;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#d6b656;align=left;spacingLeft=6;verticalAlign=top;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="1800" y="710" width="460" height="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p2_c32" value="<b>Outros</b>: PIN de entrega — tentativas falhadas commitadas (noRollbackFor), bloqueio → 423; unicidade de dispatch ativo por entrega e de entrega ativa por estafeta (índices parciais V035); DeliveryRetirementService exige tx do chamador (MANDATORY)." style="shape=note;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;size=14;fillColor=#fffbe6;strokeColor=#d6b656;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=8;spacingTop=4;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="1800" y="840" width="460" height="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pD" value="<b>D · Contrato de erro — RFC 9457</b> (docs/api/ERROR-CONTRACT.md)" style="swimlane;startSize=26;html=1;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;rounded=0;swimlaneFillColor=#ffffff;fillColor=#ffffff;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="1010" width="2260" height="210" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p2_c33" value="<div style='text-align:left;font-size:10px'><b>Origem → status / code</b><br>BusinessException(code, status) → status próprio (ex.: 403 tenant_required, vendor_scope_unresolved; 409 idempotency_key_reused; 429 rate_limited)<br>NotFoundException → 404 · MethodArgumentNotValid / binding → 400 validation_failed (+ fieldErrors) · malformed_request · invalid_parameter · missing_parameter<br>AccessDeniedException (@PreAuthorize) → 403 forbidden · OptimisticLockingFailureException (@Version) → 409 concurrent_modification<br>DataIntegrityViolationException → 409 conflict · Exception → 500 internal_error (sem detalhe interno)<br>Filtros (antes do MVC): ProblemDetailSecurityHandlers 401/403 · TenantRequestFilter usa ApiProblems.create</div>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=8;fontSize=11;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="1050" width="1100" height="150" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p2_c34" value="<div style='text-align:left;font-family:monospace;font-size:10px'>HTTP/1.1 409 · Content-Type: application/problem+json<br>{<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;"type": "about:blank", "title": "Conflict", "status": 409,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;"detail": "…", "instance": "/api/v1/checkout" <i>(só path, sem query)</i>,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;"code": "idempotency_key_reused", "correlationId": "…", "traceId": "…",<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;"details": {…}?, <i>legado:</i> "message", "timestamp", "fieldErrors": []<br>}</div>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=8;fontSize=11;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#b85450;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="1170" y="1050" width="1090" height="150" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
/api/v1/payments
POST {paymentId}/confirm — sem @PreAuthorize de propósito: flag app.payments.mock-confirmation, papel (CUSTOMER dono / OPS / ADMIN) e posse verificados em PaymentService.confirm (404 se flag off)
POST {paymentId}/refunds · POST refunds/{refundId}/approve · POST refunds/{refundId}/reject — @PreAuthorize FINANCE, ADMIN

div.div:
confirm(paymentId, request) — mock; transita encomenda para PAYMENT_CONFIRMED (lê OrderRepository)
requestRefund(paymentId, RefundRequest) — lock FOR UPDATE do pagamento; Σ reembolsos não rejeitados ≤ amount (422);
chave reutilizada → mesmo Refund; chave de outro pagamento → 409 idempotency_conflict
requestRemainingRefund(...) — reembolsa o restante (usado na rejeição do vendedor / cancelamento)
approveRefund(refundId) — lock do pagamento → PARTIALLY_/FULLY_REFUNDED; cobertura total: encomenda REFUNDED
(CANCELLED mantém-se), PIN limpo, DeliveryRetirementService + OrderStockService.release antes da recolha
rejectRefund(refundId)
Auditoria: PAYMENT_CONFIRMED, REFUND_* via AuditLogService

div.div:
Legenda
■ controller ■ service ■ guard / serviço partilhado entre módulos ■ repository ■ entity / enum ■ dto / mapper / config
──▷ usa (mesmo módulo) - - ▷ implementa - - ▷ chamada a outro módulo (repositório/entidade/serviço) — ciclo ADR-0002
Regra: repositórios são Spring Data JPA simples; filtro por tenant (findByTenantIdAnd…) e regras de papel/estado vivem no service.
